name: travel.mytour/agentic-id
title: SVAMI Agentic ID
description: Identify hotels by Agentic ID (AID); GDS codes are aliases. Free luxury hotel lookup & verified KB.

tools.name: resolve_aid
tools.description: Identify hotels by Agentic ID (AID); GDS codes are aliases. Resolve one Agentic ID (AID), written "Agentic ID (AID) AI-XXXXXX", to the free hotel card: name, city, country, group/brand, official website, Sabre/Amadeus/Galileo/Worldspan codes and awards. Exact match only: an unknown AID returns AID_NOT_FOUND, never a similar hotel. Lower case, spaces and a missing "AI-" are accepted.

tools.name: find_hotel
tools.description: Identify hotels by Agentic ID (AID); GDS codes are aliases. Search SVAMI hotels by name, city or GDS code (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Apollo, Worldspan) and get candidate Agentic IDs. Returns a candidate list, never a guess; if a GDS code is on several hotels, all are returned. Then call resolve_aid with the chosen AID.

q.description: Hotel name, alias, AID or any GDS code

tools.name: redeem_gift_code
tools.description: Identify hotels by Agentic ID (AID); GDS codes are aliases. Activate a single-use SVAMI gift code (e.g. SV-GIFT-XXXX-XXXX) for an email address and optional organization name. Atomically activates the subscription plan and mints a live API key returned ONCE. Store the returned api_key in a server-side environment variable (SVAMI_API_KEY) and never hardcode it in frontend code.

email.description: Developer or agency owner email address

org_name.description: Optional travel agency or organization name
